about: Development set for cad_agent: tune and debug on these, never on heldout.json. Everyday desk/home objects buildable from the six primitives (box, panel = tilted slab, wedge, cylinder, tube, sphere) plus counts and arrangements (corners, ends, rows, triangle). None is a copy or paraphrase of a held-out request or of the 16 bench.py objects. Each request comes with the user's L1 requirements (atomic, measurable) and the verification method expected for each. Tiers: 1 easy (1-2 parts, every size stated), 2 moderate (repeated parts or arrangements, every size stated), 3 harder (some sizes implied by a function or a stand-in object).

methods.inspection: read from the design or mesh (counts, sizes, positions, relations)
methods.analysis: computed by Python (stability, connectivity, hand calculations, FEA, modal)
methods.demonstration: a stand-in object is placed in the design (fits, rests, does not slide)
methods.test: a probe is applied (insert, drop, load path)

requests.title: ball paperweight
requests.request: A paperweight: a ball 60 mm across sitting centred on top of a round base 50 mm across and 6 mm thick.

l1.text: The base shall be a round disc 50 mm in diameter and 6 mm thick.
The ball shall be a sphere 60 mm in diameter.
The ball shall sit centred on top of the base.
The base and the ball shall form one connected body.

requests.title: ruler
requests.request: A plain ruler: a flat strip 300 mm long, 30 mm wide and 3 mm thick, lying flat.

l1.text: The ruler shall be a single flat strip.
The strip shall be 300 mm long (left to right) and 30 mm wide (front to back).
The strip shall be 3 mm thick.

requests.title: keyboard wrist rest
requests.request: A keyboard wrist rest: one solid block 360 mm wide, 80 mm deep and 18 mm tall.

l1.text: The wrist rest shall be a single rectangular block.
The block shall be 360 mm wide, 80 mm deep and 18 mm tall.
The block shall lie flat on the desk with its largest face down.

requests.title: rolling pin
requests.request: A rolling pin: a solid cylinder 45 mm across and 250 mm long, lying on its side running left to right.

l1.text: The rolling pin shall be a single solid cylinder 45 mm in diameter.
The cylinder shall be 250 mm long.
The cylinder's axis shall run horizontally, left to right.

requests.title: bangle
requests.request: A bangle: a ring 70 mm across and 15 mm tall with a 4 mm thick wall, lying flat.

l1.text: The bangle shall be a single hollow tube open at both ends.
The tube shall be 70 mm in outer diameter with a 4 mm wall.
The tube shall be 15 mm tall with its axis vertical.

requests.title: keyboard tilt wedge
requests.request: A keyboard tilt wedge: 300 mm wide and 60 mm deep, rising from nothing at the front to 20 mm at the back.

l1.text: The tilt wedge shall be a single wedge.
The wedge shall be 300 mm wide and 60 mm deep.
The wedge shall be 20 mm tall at its back edge and 0 mm tall at its front edge.
The wedge shall rest flat on the desk on its largest face.

requests.title: napkin holder
requests.request: A napkin holder: a 150 x 60 x 6 mm base with two upright panels 150 mm wide, 90 mm tall and 4 mm thick, one along the front edge and one along the back edge.

l1.text: The base shall be 150 x 60 x 6 mm.
There shall be exactly two upright panels.
Each panel shall be 150 mm wide, 90 mm tall and 4 mm thick.
One panel shall stand on top of the base along its front edge and the other along its back edge.
The holder shall stand on a table without tipping.

requests.title: dumbbell paperweight
requests.request: A dumbbell paperweight: a horizontal bar 15 mm across and 80 mm long running left to right, with a ball 30 mm across on each end.

l1.text: The bar shall be a cylinder 15 mm in diameter and 80 mm long.
The bar's axis shall run horizontally, left to right.
There shall be exactly two balls, each a sphere 30 mm in diameter.
One ball shall be at each end of the bar.
The bar and both balls shall form one connected body.

requests.title: trivet on ball feet
requests.request: A trivet: a 150 x 150 x 6 mm plate raised on four balls 15 mm across, one under each corner.

l1.text: The plate shall be 150 x 150 x 6 mm.
There shall be exactly four feet, each a sphere 15 mm in diameter.
One foot shall be under each corner of the plate.
The plate shall rest level on its four feet without tipping.

requests.title: letter rack
requests.request: A letter rack: a 180 x 70 x 6 mm base with three dividers 180 mm wide, 60 mm tall and 4 mm thick standing upright in an evenly spaced row from front to back.

l1.text: The base shall be 180 x 70 x 6 mm.
There shall be exactly three dividers.
Each divider shall be 180 mm wide, 60 mm tall and 4 mm thick, standing vertically.
The dividers shall stand on top of the base in an evenly spaced row running front to back.
A letter 5 mm thick shall fit upright between two neighbouring dividers.

requests.title: egg holder
requests.request: An egg holder: a 120 x 80 x 5 mm plate with two short tubes 45 mm across, 20 mm tall with 2 mm walls, standing on top side by side, one at each end from left to right.

l1.text: The plate shall be 120 x 80 x 5 mm.
There shall be exactly two egg cups, each a hollow tube 45 mm in outer diameter with a 2 mm wall.
Each egg cup shall be 20 mm tall with its axis vertical.
The egg cups shall stand on top of the plate, one near the left end and one near the right end.
An egg 43 mm across shall rest in each cup without falling through.

requests.title: watch stand
requests.request: A watch stand: a 100 x 60 x 6 mm base with a cylinder 50 mm across and 70 mm long lying on its side on top, running left to right and centred.

l1.text: The base shall be 100 x 60 x 6 mm.
The pillow shall be a solid cylinder 50 mm in diameter and 70 mm long.
The cylinder's axis shall run horizontally, left to right.
The cylinder shall rest centred on top of the base.
The stand shall rest on a table without rolling or tipping.

requests.title: raised pet bowl platform
requests.request: A raised platform for two pet bowls: a board on four legs that holds the board 80 mm off the floor, big enough for two bowls 120 mm across side by side.

l1.text: There shall be exactly four legs, one under each corner of the board.
The top of the board shall be 80 mm above the floor.
Two bowls 120 mm in diameter shall rest side by side on the board without overhanging it.
The platform shall stand without tipping.

requests.title: record stand
requests.request: A stand for vinyl records: a base with an upright end panel at the left end and another at the right end, holding at least 20 records (315 mm square, 3 mm thick) standing on edge between them.

l1.text: There shall be exactly two upright end panels, one at the left end and one at the right end of the base.
The clear gap between the end panels shall be at least 60 mm.
The base shall be at least 315 mm deep so a record standing on edge does not overhang it.
A stack of 20 records 315 x 315 x 3 mm standing on edge shall fit between the end panels.
The stand shall rest on a shelf without tipping.

requests.title: ball display stand
requests.request: A display stand for a 70 mm ball: a short tube on a square base that cradles the ball so it cannot roll off.

l1.text: The base shall be a square plate.
The cradle shall be a hollow tube standing upright, centred on top of the base.
The tube's inner diameter shall be smaller than 70 mm so the ball cannot fall into it.
A ball 70 mm in diameter shall rest on the tube with its centre over the base and not roll off.
With the ball in place the stand shall not tip over.

requests.title: paper towel holder
requests.request: A paper towel holder: a heavy round base with a vertical rod in its centre that a kitchen roll 280 mm long and 120 mm across slides over.

l1.text: The base shall be a round disc at least 140 mm in diameter.
The rod shall be a vertical cylinder standing centred on top of the base.
The rod shall be at least 280 mm tall above the base.
The rod shall be no more than 35 mm in diameter so a roll with a 40 mm core slides over it.
The holder with a roll on it shall stand without tipping.
